info.name: Turiino App API
info.description:
Complete API collection for Turiino App — Auth, Mentor, Teacher, Student, Chat (Reverb), Common endpoints.

Base URL variable: {{base_url}}  →  http://127.0.0.1:8001/api/v1
Auth token variable: {{token}}  →  set automatically by Login / OTP-Verify test scripts

Reverb WebSocket: ws://127.0.0.1:8080/app/toriino_ws_key_2026
Channel auth: POST {{base_url}}/broadcasting/auth

item.name: Chat (Reverb — Real-time)
item.description:
One-to-one chat between any two users (mentor ↔ student, teacher ↔ student, student ↔ student, mentor ↔ teacher).

WebSocket: ws://127.0.0.1:8080/app/toriino_ws_key_2026
Subscribe to private channel: private-conversation.{id}
Event to listen: message.sent

request.description: Returns all conversations with last message preview and unread count. Sorted by last_message_at.

Opens an existing conversation or creates a new one. Returns conversation + channel name to subscribe to.

Use this when the user taps the chat bubble on a session card — pass the mentor/student user_id.
50 messages per page, newest first. Also auto-marks the other person's messages as read.
Fires MessageSent event on private-conversation.{id} channel via Reverb. The other participant receives it in real-time.

Called by the mobile SDK (Laravel Echo / Pusher-js) to authenticate a private channel subscription.

Returns a signed auth string to pass to the Reverb WebSocket server.
